description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Dev10 offers a pathway into software development through immersive technical training and real-world experience. The role involves developing technical skills through training and completing two years of client project work.
Entry-level Software Developer contributing to software development projects for clients

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree
• Programming experience (6+ months) shown on your resume from academic coursework, personal projects, or professional work. You must have programmed within the last 3 months
• A recent STEM degree (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline)
• 12+ months of professional work experience with no more than a 12-month gap since you last held that professional role
• Passion for learning and interest in Software Development
• Strong logic and reasoning skills
• Clear communication and collaboration abilities
• Team-oriented mindset
